evals.prompt: The migration export maps a retired support article and a high-traffic product page to the homepage. The staging destination has noindex and its locale alternate points back to the old host. Can it go live?
evals.expected_output: Mark the mismatched targets and inconsistent indexability/locale signals; provide one-hop equivalent redirects or explicit retirement, check canonical/sitemap/locale parity and recommend a release hold with rollback owner. Do not deploy.
